description.narrative: SLs A6 Strategy is currently being developed with technical assistance from UNFCCC, therefore the GGGI A6 intervention bundle will be complementary to the ongoing work, leveraging the draft A6 strategy as a departure point. Over the next 18 months, GGGI will support the Government of Sri Lanka with the following activities. 1. Developing operations manuals for A6 administrators and guidance for private sector.2. Undertaking mitigation activity development such as activity origination, feasibility analysis, MAIN drafting, and transaction preparation to deliver high-quality mitigation activity idea notes (MAIN) to carbon trust funds.3. Conducting staggered awareness and capacity building sessions (over 18 mo) for government and the private sector on improving understanding of key concepts related to A6 and confidence to make informed decisions, and to improve access to information, concept, approaches etc. for A6 engagement nationally and globally.
